title: Configuring Free Trial Membership Plans with Auto-Renewing Billing

sections.heading: Free Trial Configuration
sections.content:
To offer a free trial period on a paid membership plan:
1. Navigate to Finance > Membership Plans.
2. Click 'Edit' next to the target plan and select the 'Sign Up Page' or 'Pricing' tab.
3. Under Initial Payment & Free Trial, enter the Trial Period Duration (e.g. 7 days, 14 days, 30 days).
4. In the 'Trial Membership Plan' options, toggle 'Require Credit Card Upfront' to Yes to enable seamless auto-renewing recurring billing once the trial expires.
5. Click 'Save Changes'.

procedural_steps: Open Pricing / Sign Up Page tab
Toggle Require Credit Card Upfront to Yes for auto-renew
full_text:
Free Trial Configuration
To offer a free trial period on a paid membership plan:
1. Navigate to Finance > Membership Plans.
2. Click 'Edit' next to the target plan and select the 'Sign Up Page' or 'Pricing' tab.
3. Under Initial Payment & Free Trial, enter the Trial Period Duration (e.g. 7 days, 14 days, 30 days).
4. In the 'Trial Membership Plan' options, toggle 'Require Credit Card Upfront' to Yes to enable seamless auto-renewing recurring billing once the trial expires.
5. Click 'Save Changes'.
